ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High global contrast between high-intensity (white) distal regions and low-intensity (black) central axial region; white pixels account for approximately 65-70% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous high-intensity white blobs occupy the lateral lobes; a central low-intensity black wedge originates at the peduncle and tapers toward the notch, with heavy stippling and mottling at the internal interfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch; calculated internal angle of approximately 52 degrees; bounding-box depth is significant relative to the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency, variable-amplitude serrations; approximately 14 distinct peaks visible on the right lobe and 11 on the left lobe, isolated from the background gradient.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the medial trailing edge transitioning to a convex curve at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular pixel clusters (diameters 5-15 pixels) concentrated within the central black pigmentation and at the distal tips, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense collection of fine, unaligned high-contrast linear disruptions (white on black) primarily oriented vertically in the central lower-third of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of high-intensity calcified structures (barnacles) on the extreme distal tips and along the right-side trailing edge; one distinct circular mark on the right lobe white field.
